fields.description:
Set four fields as mandatory on Partner. Show these fields first in the new Partner creation flow, ahead of every other field.

## Fields

* Name

* Logo

* Partner Portal

* Primary Contact

## Implementation Requirements

* Mark all four fields as required at creation.

* Order these four fields first in the new Partner creation layout.

## Notes

* This overlaps with BUILD-267 (Name field as a required input). Build both together if convenient.

## Source

Emily Vandenberg, Wagertech feedback — Operator & Partner Record Pages doc, WAGERTECH Feedback PARTNER section: "Mandatory fields: Name, Logo, Partner Portal, Primary Contact — these should surface to the first inputs displayed when creating new for easy user experience."
fields.summary: BUILD-269 — Partner: Surface mandatory fields as first inputs on new Partner creation

comments.body:
Logo field is a formula:

`IMAGE(Logo_URL__c, " " & Name , 30, 30)`

Made the Logo URL required only on the page layout record

Logo_URL__c originally lived in the "More Info" tab, gated by a Set Component Visibility filter Since that tab isn't part of the default view, the field's Required state wasn't visible until a user scrolled into that tab — meaning a save attempt from the default view alone would fail with no visible cause. 

**Change made:**

* Moved Logo_URL__c out of the "More Info" tab into the Partner Details section, alongside Name, Partner Portal, and Primary Contact.
* Re-applied the same Set Component Visibility filter directly on this field instead

**Partner Code is also being made mandatory — handled on** [**BUILD-274 — Account: Auto-generate Operator and Partner External IDs**](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1218294343924521/f/)**, no change needed here (2026-09-08)**

Heads-up so the two cards don't collide. `Partner_Code__c` is not in Emily's mandatory list on this ticket (Name, Logo, Partner Portal, Primary Contact), but it is being made required as part of BUILD-274 — Salesforce will start generating `Partner_External_ID__c` from it, and that value is also embedded in every Deal External Deal ID sent to the CMS. A blank code would leave both keys unbuildable.

**No edit to this ticket is needed** — the requirement, the Dynamic-Forms setting and the field description all sit on BUILD-274. Two things worth knowing if you build this one first:

* Same mechanism as this card: required via Dynamic Forms on the record page, plus the New Partner modal if it still renders the classic layout. Not field-level required, no validation rule.
* If you are already in the Partner creation layout for these four fields, adding Partner Code at the same time saves a second pass — it belongs near Partner Name / Partner Type.

Note it is a Jumpr-originated requirement rather than part of Emily's list, so it should be raised with her rather than appearing as a new required field unannounced. All 5 existing Partners already have codes, so nothing existing is blocked.
